Is this really Africa? Welcome to Seychelles, one of Africa's most fascinating island nations, famous for its turquoise beaches, luxury tourism and peaceful island lifestyle!
In this Seychelles travel vlog in Hindi, we explore Mahé Island, Anse Royale Beach and Victoria, the capital of Seychelles. From local supermarkets and everyday prices to Indian shops, a beautiful Hindu temple, local transport and luxury yachts at Eden Island, we discover what life is really like in this small African country.
